name: Per-task cloud VM
note: Fresh isolated VM for each task
summary: Each task or session gets its own short-lived virtual machine in the vendor's cloud, built from a saved environment such as repositories, setup steps and a network policy. Work continues while the user's laptop is closed, and tasks don't share state because each VM is paused or discarded afterwards.
how: Define an environment: repositories, setup script, network access, secrets
Each new task starts in a fresh VM built from that environment
The agent edits and runs code inside it, behind an egress proxy
Results come back as files, a branch or a pull request; the VM is reclaimed
facts: Claude Code cloud sessions, Codex Cloud, Claude Cowork (sessions in the cloud)
Proxies keep secrets outside the VM (Claude Code network secrets, Codex network secrets)
Isolated and runs unattended, but can't see local files, processes or VPN
goodFor: Working on repositories you don't trust locally
watchOut: Local files, browser sign-ins and VPN access aren't carried over
Idle VMs are reclaimed, so unfinished background work can be lost
